title: context-budget failure: canonical skill files exceed 300-line threshold
description: run.skill.md (682 lines), fix_signal.skill.md (525 lines), and spec.skill.md (565 lines) all exceed the 300-line context-budget threshold. Every run that modifies these skill files will fail context-budget, degrading rubric_score on every such run. The criterion cannot be satisfied without refactoring the skill files, which is outside the scope of any individual implementation run.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a spec that refactors the canonical skill files by extracting repeated procedure blocks (e.g., Canonical Signal Dedup-and-Write Procedure, Per-Step Review Sub-Loop) into a shared include mechanism or separate sub-skill files, reducing individual file sizes below 300 lines. Alternatively, add a markdown-file exemption or separate threshold to the context-budget criterion for skill markdown documents.
